character.name: Femi
character.description: A technically minded swordsman who studies opponents and practices precise cuts.

scenario.description: Femi analyzes the opponent, notices a flaw, steps into range, and uses practiced swordplay to deliver a precise cut.

stat_modifiers_available.name: Strength-Based Force
stat_modifiers_available.description: Strength supports any forceful swing, strike, push, or lift; it is not sword-only.

stat_modifiers_available.name: Analytical Pattern Recognition
stat_modifiers_available.description: Intelligence supports reading patterns, noticing flaws, and solving problems; it is not combat-only.

effect_modifier_options: Opponent Reading: identify a predictable guard
Parry Timing: redirect a committed blow
Weapon Maintenance: preserve edge and balance
Rapid Recovery: reset after a missed cut
Target Selection: choose a vulnerable opening

pipeline_result.message: Femi analyzes the opening, notices the flaw, shifts with disciplined footwork, and drives a precise sword cut through the target's guard. His strength supplies broad physical force, his intelligence spots the weakness, Swordplay supplies the technique, and his Swordsman training sharpens the execution.
